literal_meaning: পথে এবং ঘাটে (roads and riverbanks or steps)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পথেঘাটে ঘুরে বেড়িয়ে সবাইকে খবরটা বলে দিচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is spreading the news far and wide.
The rumor has spread all over the place.
note: The idiom evokes the bustling public spaces in Bengali rural and semi-urban life, where paths and ghats are central to community interactions.
